description_en: Queries the history of specified or all alert rule settings
description_zh: 查询指定或全部报警规则设置历史
name: ListAlarmHistory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert rule
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 100
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. The default value is 24 hours before the current time. You can specify a long-type timestamp or a value in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据开始时间，默认24小时前，可以输入long型时间，也可以输入yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss类型时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The default value is the current time. You can specify a long-type timestamp or a value in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据结束时间，默认当前时间，可以输入long型时间，也可以输入yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss类型时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The cursor that specifies the start position of the query. If this parameter is left empty, the first 100 records are returned in reverse chronological order
parameters.help_zh: 查询数据的起始位置，为空则按时间查询前100条
parameters.name: cursor

AlarmHistory.description_en: The list of alert history details

AlarmTime.description_en: The time when the alert was triggered

ContactGroups.description_en: The contact group of the alert notification. The value is a JSON array string, for example, `["contact group 1","contact group 2"]`. This field is returned only when the notification status is 0
ContactGroups.description_zh: 发出的报警通知的通知对象，json array对应的字符串，例如`[“联系组1”:”联系组2”]`，只有通知状态为0才有该字段。

Dimension.description_en: The instance associated with the alert rule. The value is a JSON object string, for example, {"instance":"name1"}
Dimension.description_zh: 报警规则对应实例，为json object对应的字符串,例如{“instance”:”name1”}

EvaluationCount.description_en: The number of consecutive detection times that the threshold condition must be met before an alert is triggered
EvaluationCount.description_zh: 连续探测几次都满足阈值条件时报警

Id.description_en: The ID of the alert rule

LastTime.description_en: The duration of the alert. Unit: milliseconds
LastTime.description_zh: 报警持续时间，单位为毫秒

Name.description_en: The name of the alert rule

Namespace.description_en: The namespace of the cloud service

State.description_en: The status of the alert rule. Valid values: OK, ALARM, and INSUFFICIENT_DATA
State.description_zh: 报警规则状态，有OK，ALARM，INSUFFICIENT_DATA三种状态。

Status.description_en: The notification sending status. Valid values: 0: The user has been notified. 1: The notification was not sent because the alert rule was not in the effective period. 2: The notification was not sent because the alert was in the mute period
Status.description_zh: 通知发送状态，0为已通知用户，1为不在生效期未通知，2为处于报警沉默期未通知。

Value.description_en: The current value when the alert was triggered

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value 200 indicates success. A non-200 value indicates failure
Code.description_zh: 请求失败状态码，200为成功，非200为失败。

Cursor.description_en: The cursor for the next page. An empty value indicates that no more pages are available
Cursor.description_zh: 下一页数据，为空代表没有下一页

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to query logs

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
